about.heading: About me
about.animated: I build end-to-end AI systems: framing the problem, preparing the data, modeling and evaluation, then shipping it as an API, a RAG assistant or a conversational agent. In 2026, two AI / ML internships at Mawaba Technologies and AnalystLab Africa. Let's build something useful together!
about.label: 01 — About
about.title: From raw data to AI systems that matter.
about.p1: I'm Light DJOSSOU, an AI & Machine Learning Engineer in training at the École Nationale Polytechnique in Lomé (BSc in AI & Big Data). My focus is the full lifecycle of an AI project: framing the problem, then delivering an evaluated model served through an API, a RAG assistant or a conversational agent.
about.p2: In 2026 I completed two AI / ML internships back to back: a RAG assistant for ARCEP at Mawaba Technologies, then a customer churn prediction project at AnalystLab Africa, while building software in a team at Neuractif Initiatives. My goal: put AI to work for businesses and African entrepreneurship.

items.title: Predictive Machine Learning

items.title: RAG & Generative AI

items.title: Conversational agents

analystlab.context: Customer churn prediction — Telco dataset (7,043 customers, 21 features)
points: Business framing: defined the target variable, evaluation metrics and candidate algorithms.
Documented preprocessing: missing values, encoding, scaling, outlier treatment (IQR, Z-score).
Feature engineering (3 new features), feature selection, training and comparison of classification models with scikit-learn.
Built a RAG assistant with LangChain and ChromaDB, integrating LLMs (Mistral, Gemini).
Natural-language querying of a document corpus with source-grounded answers.
Deepened skills in LLM architectures, RAG pipelines, prompt engineering and data analysis.
Software and AI development in a team, in an agile project setting.
Contributing to digital projects with an educational and social purpose.

projects.heading: Projects
projects.label: 05 — Projects
projects.title: Selected AI projects
projects.subtitle: Machine Learning, RAG, agents and AI products, built during internships, hackathons or on my own.

oren.title: Oren
oren.desc: AI assistant platform for small businesses in French-speaking Africa. From a photo of the menu and a voice message, an owner gets an assistant in under an hour that answers customers in French, composes the order, waits for explicit confirmation, then sends it to a live dashboard.
highlights: Multi-tenant architecture, PostgreSQL Row Level Security on every table
Capability-based tool registry: the agent only gets the tools it is allowed
Multimodal onboarding: vision on menu photos and voice transcription

arcep.title: ARCEP RAG assistant
arcep.desc: Natural-language querying of ARCEP's document corpus, with answers grounded in the sources.

churn.title: Customer Churn Prediction
churn.desc: End-to-end pipeline on 7,043 telecom customers: cleaning, 3 engineered features, encoding, outlier treatment, feature selection and comparison of classification models.

credit.title: Credit Scoring
credit.desc: Loan default prediction on Home Credit Default Risk (~8% defaults): multi-table feature engineering, LightGBM, SHAP explainability, a decision threshold based on business cost, served through an API.

otr.title: OTR tax RAG
otr.desc: Assistant for Togolese tax law. A PDF → Markdown extraction pipeline that preserves the legal structure (books, titles, articles, footnotes) for reliable chunking and precise citations. 61 automated tests.

belvedere.title: Hôtel Belvédère RAG
belvedere.desc: A system combining SQL queries and an LLM to answer guests' questions from the hotel's own data.

orderbot.title: LIGHTFOOD OrderBot
orderbot.desc: Restaurant ordering agent: multi-turn dialogue with memory, per-user session isolation, automatic total calculation, prompt engineering.

pulse.title: Pulse AI
pulse.desc: AI symptom analysis, routing to the right healthcare facility and mental health support for West Africa, in French, English, Hausa, Yoruba and Ewe.

flyai.title: Fly AI
flyai.desc: A platform that helps African students find scholarships, strengthen their applications and maximise their chances with personalised recommendations.
